newsitem.title: UK: Chiroscience shares gain on drug news.
newsitem.headline: Chiroscience shares gain on drug news.

text.p: Shares in Chiroscience Group Plc were boosted in late morning by news of progress on the group's long-acting local anaesthetic Levobupivacaine.

Shares in Chiroscience rose 13 pence to 379, after touching a high of 383 pence, after the company said late-stage trials of the drug in childbirth showed that an almost equal amount was required to control pain as the generic version, bupivacaine.
The Chiroscience product, which is effectively a purified version of bupivacaine, has side-effect advantages over the original, which has been associated with heart problems.
